description.id: Sejak 2022, Digvation membantu usaha kecil dan menengah menjalani digitalisasi, dari website dan sistem kerja sampai pendampingan setelah digunakan.
description.en: Since 2022, Digvation has helped small and medium businesses go digital, from websites and everyday systems to support after launch.

responseNote.id: Kita mulai dari cerita bisnis kalian. Kebutuhan, ruang lingkup, dan pendampingan dibahas bersama sebelum proyek berjalan.
responseNote.en: We start with your business story. Needs, scope and ongoing support are agreed together before the project begins.
